label: Slovenská bryndza
note: Slovak PGI: up to 50% cow lump cheese

about.text: Slovenská bryndza is a Slovak PGI cheese: ground sheep lump cheese, or sheep lump cheese mixed with up to 50% cow lump cheese, with salt (OJ C 232/2007).

links.name: Slovenská bryndza PGI summary, OJ C 232/2007

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Lump cheese is 100 % sheep, or mixed with up to 50 % cow
Sheep milk is 'sweetened' (set) at the mountain hut; the lump cheese is dried there and taken to the bryndziarna (bryndza dairy)
Slovak PGI; production area is the mountainous part of Slovakia
